"""Good: a challenge is detected and reported, never bypassed (LINT-02)."""


def run(self, entity, ctx):
    res = self.result(entity)
    resp = ctx.http.get("https://www.example.com/search?q=" + entity.value)
    if "cf-chl" in resp.text or resp.status == 403:
        return res.mark("blocked", "anti-bot challenge: could not verify", reason_code="challenge")
    return res
